t: Flomasta PipeGrip Elbow is a pack of 5 push-fit water pipe fittings designed to turn 22mm pipe smoothly through a 90° bend. Featuring dual locking and green band indicators, they ensure secure, leak-free connections without the need for hot works. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are perfect for routing pipework around corners in larger installations.
